title: Protocol for in vitro establishment of heterogeneous stem-like cultures derived from whole human glioblastoma tumors
protocol: Aliquot UA in the appropriate number of conical tubes (40 mL/tube), collecting the entire resuspension.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 270 g, RT (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Wash pellets with 25 mL/tube PBS 1X.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 270 g, RT (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Add 25 mL/tube ACK solution for blood red cell lysis.
Vigorously flip the tube 10‒15 times or resuspend by pipetting with a 25 mL disposable pipette.
Incubate for 10–15 min at RT (+22°C–25°C) in the dark.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 270 g, RT (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Wash pellets with 15 mL/tube PBS 1X.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 270 g, RT (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Add up to 4 pellets together and resuspend each pellet in 5 mL PBS 1X, sequentially transferring the resuspension to subsequent tubes.
Transfer the pellets into 10 cm cell culture petri dishes containing 20 mL of total pellet volume.
Add 1 mL collagenase type I to each dish and incubate for 20 minutes at 37°C.
Add 3 mL PBS 1X to the dish after the incubation period.

Mechanically disrupt tissue fragments by pipetting up and down 10–15 times with a sterile 5 mL pipette, followed by passing through an 18 G needle in a 1 mL syringe until the tumor resuspension turns velvety.
If mechanical disruption is difficult, incubate dishes at +37°C for additional 10 minutes to prolong collagenase activity (note: long incubation can reduce cell viability).
Collect tumor resuspension with a syringe and filter it through a sterile 100 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
If necessary, further dilute the high density tumor suspension with PBS 1X to facilitate filtration.
Pass the tumor suspension through a sterile 70 μm cell strainer.
Wash dish and strainers once with 5 mL PBS 1X.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 270 g, RT (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Resuspend cell pellets in the appropriate volume of GSC Medium based on the number of planned culture conditions.
Resuspend cell pellets in an appropriate volume of medium for biobanking and nucleic acid collection.
Transfer the cell resuspension into dedicated 75 cm² flasks containing GSC standard medium without GFs (1 mL/flask).
Incubate the flasks at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 20% O₂ concentration for 24 hours.
Collect each flask suspension in a dedicated 15 mL conical tube after 24 hours.
Centrifuge the collected suspensions for 10 minutes at 120 g, room temperature (+22°C to +25°C).
Discard the supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Resuspend each pellet with 10 ml of GSC standard medium containing the desired concentration and combination of GFs.
Transfer cell resuspension into 75 cm² flasks.
Maintain the cells in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO₂ and 20% O₂ concentration.
Monitor for the emergence of established neurospheres.
Propagate neurospheres by passaging when they reach around 100 μm diameter or appear dark due to dying cells.
Split the neurospheres into separate flasks while maintaining the same growth factor cocktail.
Monitor cell cultures daily by microscopic observation.
Change medium when it turns milky or dying cells are noticed.
Add or replace the medium in cultures free of non-tumor cells at least once every 3–5 days based on acidification rate.
Observe formation of GSC floating spheroids (neurospheres) derived from proliferation of a single GSC.
Stand flasks upright in the sterile biological safety cabinet for 5 minutes.
Collect 3/10 mL of exhausted medium from the top using a sterile 5 mL pipette.
Add 3 mL of freshly prepared GSC Medium with GFs (at 3X concentration) without pipetting.
Transfer flasks back to the incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2 and 20% O2 concentration.
Collect cell resuspensions in 15 mL conical tubes (one tube per flask).
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 120 g, room temperature (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration, leaving around 0.5 mL of medium.
Carefully resuspend pellet in 10 mL of fresh GSC Medium with GFs.
Transfer flasks back to the incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2 and 20% O2 concentration.
Collect medium containing cells in 15 mL conical tubes (one tube per flask).
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 120 g at room temperature (+22°C to +25°C).
Discard the supernatant by vacuum aspiration, leaving around 0.2 mL of medium.
Mechanically disrupt spheroids by vigorous up and down pipetting for 100 times using a p200 pipette.
Assess the presence of residual spheroids visually.
If necessary, pipette an additional 50 to 100 times.
Optional: Add 0.1 mL of Trypsin or collagenase type I in PBS 1X (or pure for sticky spheroids) v/v with medium.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature (+22°C to +25°C), or at 37°C if needed.
Mechanically disrupt spheroids by vigorous up and down pipetting for 100 times using a p200 pipette.
Once dissociated, wash with 5 mL of PBS 1X.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 120 g.
Discard the supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of fresh GSC Medium with growth factors.
Transfer flasks to the incubator at 37°C, with 5% CO2 and 20% O2 concentration.
Dissociate neurospheres as above.
Perform cell counts and monitor cell viability using trypan blue or other vital staining.
Dispense 4–8 × 10^5 dissociated viable cells in 10 mL of fresh GSC standard medium with GFs.
Transfer flasks to the incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 20% O2 concentration.
Transfer 1 mL of processed cell resuspension from step 26 in a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 9 mL of PBS 1X to the cell resuspension.
Estimate total cell number by using an automated cell counter.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 150 g, RT (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Resuspend the pellet at a concentration of 2×10^6 cells/mL in PBS 1X with 1% BSA.
Transfer 0.5 mL of resuspended cells to each of four 5 mL polystyrene FACS tubes.
Prepare one NEGATIVE CONTROL TUBE with unstained cells.
Prepare one COMPENSATION TUBE for single CD45 stained cells.
Prepare one COMPENSATION TUBE for single CD56 stained cells.
Add both CD45 and CD56 antibodies to the SAMPLE TUBE.
Add CD45 PE-CF594 antibody at a 1:20 dilution (e.g., 25 μL of antibody in 500 μL PBS 1X-1% BSA).
Add CD56 PE-Cy7 antibody at a 1:20 dilution (e.g., 25 μL of antibody in 500 μL PBS 1X-1% BSA).
Vortex tubes and incubate 20 min at room temperature (+22°C–25°C), on a rocking platform, in the dark.
Add 2 mL of PBS 1X to each tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 150 g at room temperature (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by decanting.
Resuspend all pellets in 300 μL of DAPI 0.2X solution for staining the viable population (DAPIneg).
Filter samples using Falcon Round-Bottom Polystyrene Test Tubes with Cell Strainer Snap Cap, 5 mL or alternatively by CellTrics 50 μm.
Immediately acquire samples by flow cytometry.
Set the first gate on Forward Scatter (FSC)/Side Scatter (SSC) to exclude debris.
Within this population, exclude doublets and aggregates by evaluating the Pulse Width on a physical parameter (FSC or SSC).
Select the viable population that has not incorporated DAPI (DAPIneg).
Combine these three gates to define healthy single cells where CD45/CD56 expression should be analyzed.
Analyze data using Beckman Coulter Kaluza Flow Analysis Software 1.3 or equivalent.
Resuspend a part of tumor cells in GSC Medium at the end of derivation protocol.
Aliquot 0.8 mL of tumor cell resuspension into 3–4 cryogenic vials.
Add 0.1 mL of additional BSA to each vial.
Add 0.1 mL of dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) to each vial.
Place vials on wet ice for no more than 5 minutes.
Transfer vials to an insulated box placed at -80°C freezer.
After 24–48 hours, transfer vials to liquid nitrogen storage.
Thaw cryogenic vials carefully in a water bath at 37°C for rapid warming.
Resuspend thawed cells gently and transfer to culture medium immediately.
Rapidly thaw frozen cells in a 37°C water bath.
Dilute cells slowly in pre-warmed GSC Medium without GFs.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 120 g, room temperature (+22°C–25°C).
Gently resuspend the pellet in a 75 cm² flask containing 10–15 mL of pre-warmed GSC Medium without GFs.
Transfer flasks to an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO₂ and 20% O₂ concentration for 24 hours.
Collect medium containing cells in 15 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 120 g, room temperature (+22°C–25°C).
Resuspend the pellet to obtain 1 mL of cell resuspension for each desired culture.
Transfer the suspension into 75 cm² flasks containing different concentrations and combinations of GFs.
Maintain cultures in an incubator at 37°C with monitored CO₂ and 20% O₂ concentration.
Add 10 mL of fixative to the pellet obtained after UA centrifugation.
Incubate for 15 min, pelleting cells by gravity.
Discard supernatant via sterile pipette.
Repeat twice until fixative and pellet are clean from blood.
Add 10 mL of fixative.
Incubate for 16–24 h at +4°C.
Discard supernatant by decanting.
Collect fixed tumor fragments with the help of sterile forceps into a bio-cassette with foam pads.
Aliquot 0.5 mL of tumor resuspension into RNase-free Eppendorf tubes.
Centrifuge the aliquots for 5 minutes at 900 g, room temperature (+22°C–25°C).
Discard the supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Store the pellets at -80°C or proceed to gDNA and total RNA extraction according to kit manufacturer’s instructions.
Transfer blood into a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 40 mL of ACK solution for blood red cell lysis.
Vigorously flip the tube 10-15 times or resuspend by pipetting with a 25 mL disposable pipette.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature (+22°C–25°C) in the dark.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 750 g, room temperature (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Resuspend pellet in 3 mL of PBS (starting from 5 mL of peripheral blood).
Aliquot into Eppendorf tubes (1 mL/Eppendorf).
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 900 g, room temperature (+22°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant by vacuum aspiration.
Store pellets at -80°C or proceed to PBMC gDNA extraction according to DNA kit manufacturer’s instructions.
